kinds.description: Replaces + with -, - with +, * with /, / with * and % with *, in an expression or a compound assignment of numbers.
Replaces < with <=, <= with <, > with >= and >= with >.
Replaces a comparison with <=, >=, == or != with true. Both operands are still evaluated.
Replaces a comparison with <, >, == or != with false. Both operands are still evaluated.
Replaces a && b or a || b with a. The right operand is not evaluated.
Replaces a && b or a || b with b. The left operand is not evaluated.
Replaces a || b with true. Neither operand is evaluated.
Replaces a && b with false. Neither operand is evaluated.
Replaces x++ with x-- and x-- with x++.
Replaces a boolean operand x with !x, and !x with x.
Replaces -x with x, where x is not a constant.
Replaces the values a return statement returns with the zero value of each result type.

families.description: Calls that write log records, and their arguments.
Calls that sleep, set a deadline or timeout, define a backoff, or wait for a service to become ready, their arguments, and calls of the cancel function that such a call returns.
Calls that register a configuration flag, and their arguments.
Arguments that only size an allocation: a capacity or a size hint.
Calls that mark a function as a test helper, which change only the location that a failure reports.
